Body.Content:
What and why

We're improving the PowerPoint Live presenting experience in Microsoft Teams by introducing a new light mode option. With this update, presenters can choose from light, dark, classic, or high contrast modes while presenting. This enhancement provides greater flexibility, accessibility, and personalization, allowing presenters to use the display mode that best matches their preferences and working environment.

This message is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 567469.

Rollout schedule

  • Targeted release: Beginning in early September 2026 and expected to complete by early September 2026
  • General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): Beginning in early September 2026 and expected to complete by late-September 2026

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Users who present PowerPoint content using PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams.

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Teams
  • PowerPoint Live

What will happen

Presenters will be able to select from the following display modes when using PowerPoint Live:

  • Light mode
  • Dark mode
  • Classic mode
  • High contrast mode

Users can choose the mode that best aligns with their preferences and accessibility needs.

This change enhances the presenting experience and does not alter presentation content or attendee viewing experiences.

Action required and recommendations

No admin action is required.

Consider informing users who regularly present in Teams meetings about the new display mode options.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

message.Title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live introduces light mode for presenters
